synthesis.paragraph: Three of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Planning and Governance," examining governance mechanisms in Central and Eastern European urban redevelopment, migrant homemaking experiences in Kathmandu, and the discursive production of territorial stigma in Callao, Peru. The tag "interview" also covers three papers, which include the study on territorial stigma in Callao, an analysis of women's labor in Turkish film festivals, and an investigation into the urban experiences of caregivers of autistic individuals in Singapore. Outside these groups, one paper evaluated the 2025 Flower Community Fair in Accra as an informal learning platform for climate adaptation, another developed waveform analysis algorithms to identify train motion parameters from railway bridge strain data, and a third modeled a multi-period inventory pickup and delivery problem for rural logistics using alternative routes.
